handoffs: | Stack safety | Upstream artifacts remain intact and downstream handoff data is complete |

protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Make instruction artifacts easier to read and invoke while preserving their behavior. Treat clarity as an editorial hypothesis, never as proof that an agent will perform better.

protected_invariants.heading: `rewrite`
protected_invariants.text: Produce a candidate rewrite. Preserve commands, modality, authority, safety, prerequisites, order, schemas, required outputs, examples, exceptions, and fallbacks unless the user explicitly authorizes a semantic change.

protected_invariants.heading: Workflow Contract
protected_invariants.text: 6. Mark contradictions or missing intent as unresolved; do not silently resolve them.

protected_invariants.heading: Stack Contract
protected_invariants.text: Preserve upstream artifact identifiers, clause hashes, unresolved questions, and requested output. Add editorial evidence; do not replace upstream evidence.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: promote the editor's own output, weaken behavior for fluency, invent missing intent, fetch Google HTML through UAC, or treat style compliance as task success

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation Hints
protected_invariants.text: Do not auto-route ordinary prose editing, general documentation architecture, prompt hardening, or capability intake here unless instruction preservation is the central job.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Use direct language only when it preserves the named actor and action.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Keep `must`, `must not`, `never`, `only`, and approval requirements exact.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not delete low-frequency modules or examples merely to reduce size.

protected_invariants.heading: Audit request
protected_invariants.text: > Audit this skill for Claude-ish phrasing and buried conditions. Do not rewrite it.

protected_invariants.heading: Audit request
protected_invariants.text: Return findings with rule IDs, clause references, and risk. Do not claim behavior improved.

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Honesty | Editorial quality is never reported as behavioral proof |

compiler_note: Draft extraction is not human approval. mapped remains zero until cases or waivers reference stable clause IDs.
